---
pagetitle: "Trump Truth Social Posts Around UCDP Iran Events"
page-layout: full
title-block-banner: false
toc: false
---

<style>
/* The wrapper already has the real site navbar. Keep the full-screen
   visualization from adding a second page footer below the iframe. */
footer.footer {
  display: none !important;
}

/* Remove Quarto's normal article top spacing so the visualization
   sits directly under the site navbar. */
#quarto-content,
main.content,
.page-columns {
  margin-top: 0 !important;
  padding-top: 0 !important;
}

/* Quarto's fixed-nav body offset can leave a thin blank strip here.
   Keep this full-screen wrapper's navbar in normal flow so the iframe
   begins immediately below it with no residual offset. */
body.nav-fixed {
  padding-top: 0 !important;
}
#quarto-header,
#quarto-header.fixed-top,
#quarto-header.headroom,
#quarto-header.headroom--pinned,
#quarto-header.headroom--unpinned {
  position: static !important;
  top: auto !important;
  transform: none !important;
  transition: none !important;
}
</style>

<div class="column-screen" style="margin: 0;">
<iframe
  id="iran-timeline-frame"
  src="assets/political-text-analysis/trump-iran-connected-timeline.html"
  style="width: 100%; height: calc(100vh - 64px); border: 0; display: block;"
  loading="lazy">
</iframe>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  const frame = document.getElementById("iran-timeline-frame");
  if (!frame) return;

  function normalizeOuterHeader() {
    document.body.classList.remove("nav-fixed");
    const header = document.getElementById("quarto-header");
    if (!header) return;
    header.classList.remove(
      "fixed-top",
      "headroom",
      "headroom--pinned",
      "headroom--unpinned"
    );
    header.style.setProperty("position", "static", "important");
    header.style.setProperty("top", "auto", "important");
    header.style.setProperty("transform", "none", "important");
    header.style.setProperty("transition", "none", "important");
  }

  normalizeOuterHeader();
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", normalizeOuterHeader);
  window.addEventListener("load", normalizeOuterHeader);

  function cleanEmbeddedChrome() {
    try {
      const doc = frame.contentDocument;
      if (!doc) return;

      const innerNav = doc.querySelector(".site-nav");
      if (innerNav) {
        innerNav.style.setProperty("display", "none", "important");
      }

      if (doc.body) {
        doc.body.classList.remove("has-shared-nav");
      }
    } catch (error) {
      /* Same-origin on the deployed site; fail quietly during local previews. */
    }
  }

  frame.addEventListener("load", cleanEmbeddedChrome);
  cleanEmbeddedChrome();
})();
</script>
